description:
Several Pharaoh queries in one call, run in parallel: codebase map, module profiles, function searches, blast radius and module dependency paths.

CALL THIS WHEN:
• Planning a change, reviewing a PR or assessing architecture, when you know what to check

RETURNS: Each requested section in one response. Per call: up to 5 modules, 3 searches, 3 blast radius targets, 3 dependency pairs.

USE INSTEAD OF: a string of separate tool calls or file reads at the start of a task.

dependencies.description: Module pairs to trace a dependency path between (max 3)

repo.description: Repository name — one of your connected repos.

name: pharaoh_recon
